Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand - Stone & Beam Primrose Upholstered Rocking Recliner Chair, 33"W, Mocha Brown
Colors: Brown
Materials: Engineered Wood
The classic mocha-brown upholstery comes in a plush but durable fabric and features slight ribbing that provides just a touch of texture to your decor. The sloping lines of this piece create a shape you can easily relax into, and the mechanisms allow you to recline or rock with ease. 33"W x 42"D x 42"H; seat height: 21"H; seat back height: 42"H; seat depth: 22"D; arm height: 26"H Kiln-dried hardwood, engineered wood, and high-density oriented strand board frame. Steel seat and back springs. High-resilience memory foam cushions. A sturdy wood frame under plush cushions provides a solid base for this chair’s classic shape, creating a winning combination of design and comfort. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Clean only with dry cleaning solvent. Do not saturate. Do not use water. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty
